english.title: Master of a coasting ship fail to report the ship touching at a place outside the UK
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) being the master of a coasting ship, namely **(..SPECIFY THE SHIP..), which touched a place outside the United Kingdom, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PLACE..), did not report that fact in writing to the proper officer at the first port at which the ship arrived thereafter
english.legislation: Contrary to section 74(1)(c) of the Customs and Excise Management Act 1979.
